Download the product summary (PDF 344 KB) What Smart/Phone Care covers What Smart/Phone Care covers When you buy a new mobile device, it comes with a limited warranty for manufacturer's defects and malfunctions. Smart/Phone Care gives you additional coverage and peace of mind, knowing that you don't have to pay the full replacement value of your device. The Smart/Phone Care plan covers your device for: Defects in parts and workmanship beyond the manufacturer's standard warranty period Physical damage (ie, cracked screen) Electronic damage (ie, power surge) Liquid damage Loss or theft Normal wear and tear Smart/Phone Care covers one device and allows for up to two replacements. The deductible for Smart/Phone Care plans starts at $50 for new devices and $49 for devices you already own. The replacement fee can range from $49 to $449, depending on your device. There may also be additional fees, such as a non-covered service fee ($100-$600) or a non-return fee ($100-$600) if the device isn't returned within 5 business days.
